articles.title: Institutional crypto trading hits a record 72% as Wall Street calms crypto's wild swings
articles.snippet: A new report from market maker Wintermute found that institutions now dominate crypto trading, driving lower volatility, selective altcoin flows and growth in tokenized assets.

articles.title: South Korea plans to tax crypto gains over $1,740 as political battle moves to parliament
articles.snippet: The country plans on taxing cryptocurrency gains from Jan. 1, 2027, signaling that it does not intend to postpone the measure for a fourth time.

articles.title: Crypto's resilience tested as oil rises after Iran strikes, Fed signals rates could still rise
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held near $64,000 despite the Fed's hawkish split, Iranian ballistic missiles and an 8% surge in oil overnight that sent the Dow down 2.2% and the Nasdaq to a three-month low.

articles.title: BitRiver founder charged in Russia with $12.5 million fraud
articles.snippet: Igor Runets has been transferred to a pre-trial detention facility from house arrest as he faces accusations of failing to deliver on a contract.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether whipsaw wipes out $286 million in leveraged bets
articles.snippet: Price volatility around the Federal Reserve's rate decision cleared positions for roughly 90,000 traders, with unusually equal losses for bulls and bears.
